name: TCHONG
recent: Tan Chong 在 2026 年第三季度亏损收窄至 1680 万令吉，尽管营收下降 13.8%。公司近期也多次就提供财务援助发布公告。

news.title: Tan Chong Q3 2026 Loss Narrows to RM16.8 Million as Margin and FX Lift Offset 13.8% Revenue Drop

recent_en: Tan Chong narrowed its Q3 2026 loss to RM16.8 million despite a 13.8% revenue decline. The company also made several announcements on the provision of financial assistance.
notable_en: Q3 2026 loss narrowed to RM16.8 million with revenue down 13.8% year-on-year.
The company announced the provision of financial assistance on 23 Nov 2026 and 8 Oct 2026.
risks_en: The company still recorded a loss of RM16.8 million in Q3 2026.
